next_direction_v119_plus.v119_gaussian_kernel_vq: RKHS Gaussian Kernel VQ: 用 exp(-||x-c||²/(2σ²)) kernel 相似度作为 argmax, 替代 Euclidean/双曲距离. σ 由 RBF bandwidth heuristic 估计 (e.g. median pairwise distance). 论文支撑: Schölkopf et al. 2002 'Learning with Kernels'. R36n 合规 (kernel distance = 几何变种). Stage 1 端纯几何变更.
next_direction_v119_plus.v120_normalizing_flow_codebook: Normalizing Flow Codebook: codebook 元素用可逆 flow (RealNVP) 表示, 量化时算 flow 的 log-det Jacobian. 论文支撑: Dinh et al. 2017 'Density Estimation using Real NVP'. R36n 合规 (flow = 几何变种). Stage 1 端纯几何变更.
next_direction_v119_plus.v121_ot_based_init_via_sinkhorn: Optimal Transport Codebook Init: 用 Sinkhorn OT 计算 (data, codebook) 之间的最优传输, codebook = barycentric projection of data via OT plan. 论文支撑: Cuturi 2013 'Sinkhorn Distances'. R36n 合规 (OT = 几何). Stage 1 端 init 变种.
